title: syringa formosissima var. hirsuta
intro: Syringa formosissima var. hirsuta, commonly known as the hairy lilac or Formosa lilac, is a variety of flowering shrub within the Syringa genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain, as well as its potential to improve respiratory and cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Syringa formosissima var. hirsuta are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
